evals.prompt: I dropped a photo of a living room. Analyze it at high and low level, file it in the catalog, and draft a real-estate listing block I can paste.
evals.expected_output: Dual-layer analysis (palette/exposure/sharpness plus scene/subjects), collection interiors, real-estate workflow with headline, listing paragraph, alt text, and a checklist. No invented sqft or address.

evals.prompt: Catalog this product packshot and write ecommerce title, bullets, and alt text from what you can actually see.
evals.expected_output: Product collection, low-level palette and aspect, high-level object description, product workflow. No invented brand or SKU.

evals.prompt: This is a crack in a concrete wall from a site visit. File it and give me a punch-list note. Don't tell me the building is failing.
evals.expected_output: Field collection, inspection workflow with severity observe/repair/urgent-review, factual finding, checklist for scale/context photos, no legal or structural verdict.
